(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-piece-canvas]'); return 'canvas ' + c.width + 'x' + c.height + ', info shown ' + document.querySelector('.um-info').hasAttribute('data-show'); })()

(async () => { const t = []; let last = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame); const n = performance.now(); t.push(n - last); last = n; } t.sort((a, b) => a - b); return 'frame interval median ' + t[30].toFixed(1) + ' ms, worst ' + t[59].toFixed(1) + ' ms'; })()
